assessment.material_result: C54 is numerically reproducible under its exact seeded toy model. Equal-marginal judge switching loses nearly all quality benefit under fully shared first-verdict dependence, materially better symmetric B remains useful in the toy even at cross_mix=1, and the asymmetric high-qFA condition reproduces the reported null result. None of this establishes real LLM judge error rates or validates the naive likelihood-ratio combination rule under dependence.
